hypothesis: The one lumped solid state cannot jointly represent fast furniture return heat immediately after 2h outage and slow construction release in 6h recovery
topology: Air exchanges with furniture and construction in parallel; only construction exchanges with unchanged relative boundary. No new supplied heat source or duplicated ventilation.
basis: Air fixed to original IDF 237.91m3*1.2kg/m3*1005J/kgK at normalized reference scale
Furniture and construction capacities each constrained to 25-100% of their disjoint original IDF material capacity; total <= original furniture+construction
Total air-solid conductance retains original 0.5-10W/m2K times full surface area; no doubled coupling bound
Fixed coupling split research range10-90%; same zone vector across durations/days
Original floor area boundary conductance proxy retained, not an OEM or measured conductance
fit_rule: One preregistered bounded least-squares attempt per physical zone; all native points uniformly weighted
prediction_inputs: actual delivered net zone sensible difference
forbidden: separate ventilation or reheat powers added to already complete net sensible input
gate: All8 strong summer original metrics pass unchanged before any new summer holdout. Weak winter reported separately.
stop: If summer calibration remains visibly inadequate, stop model expansion and no new validation background generation; retain exploratory model and explicit intervention applicability
